items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He was an arranger. He arranged some things that Duke used. And he and I... He just liked me. So later on he asked me... everybody was taking lessons from him.

ctx.x: He was a trumpet player, too, wasn't he.

Yeah, he was with Chick Webb. They wanted somewhere to jam and play, so Harry would put them on. Sometimes we'd go to work at ten o'clock, and see half-a-dozen musicians there with their horns. They wanted to play, and also at the same time make auditions.

Harry was a wonderful musician. He was an arranger. He arranged some things that Duke used. And he and I... He just liked me. So later on he asked me... Albert Morgan had come through and made a splash on the bass, and Pops Foster was with Luis Russell, and everybody was taking lessons from him. They couldn't get to Braud, because Braud was doubling with Duke, playing theatres and the Cotton Club. And he asked me, said, "Man, that's a helluva bass.
